title: Furnace ETA hud
description: Adds a clean and immersive Smelting ETA panel to furnaces, blast furnaces, and smokers, showing exact smelt times, fuel efficiency, and total completion estimates in real time.
body:
⏳ Furnace ETA
---
Furnace ETA adds a sleek side-panel HUD to Minecraft furnaces that displays precise smelting information at a glance.

No more guessing how long your items will take — the mod shows live timers, fuel status, and total batch completion estimates in a clean vanilla-friendly interface.

Perfect for survival players, technical players, builders, and anyone tired of waiting blindly for furnaces to finish.

✨ Features
---
Real-time smelting countdowns
Shows remaining time for the current item
Calculates total time for the entire stack
Fuel efficiency percentage display
Works with:
Furnaces
Blast Furnaces
Smokers
Lightweight and clean UI
Vanilla-style design
Client-side QoL mod

🖥️ Displayed Information
---
Fuel remaining %
Current item ETA
Total batch ETA
Progress bars for quick visual reading

🎮 Why Use Furnace ETA?
---
Minecraft already shows smelting progress visually, but not accurately.

Furnace ETA gives exact timing information without opening F3 menus, calculators, or external tools. The HUD is designed to feel like something that could exist in vanilla Minecraft while still being incredibly useful.

⚙️ Compatibility
---
Fabric
Client-side
Works in singleplayer and multiplayer servers
No server installation required

🧡 Designed for Vanilla+
---
The goal of Furnace ETA is simple:

Make furnaces feel smarter without changing vanilla gameplay.

No automation.
No balance changes.
Just better information.
